summary_en: Upper limit ¥5.88B, 3.5M shares (1.72% of S/O), execution window 12 Aug 2026 to 26 Feb 2027, via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchase. No price ceiling disclosed. Stated purpose: capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Pursuant to Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the Company's Articles of Incorporation)
translation_en_brief: On 10 August 2026, BLUE ZONES HOLDINGS' board of directors authorized acquisition of up to 3.5 million ordinary shares (1.72% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥5.88 billion. The company will execute purchases via ToSTNeT-3 dark-pool trades and open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 12 August 2026 and 26 February 2027. No price ceiling was disclosed. The board cited capital efficiency, enhanced shareholder returns, and the need for flexible capital policy in response to future business conditions as the rationale. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 5.84 million treasury shares against 203.6 million shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
